method: Each task started a fresh ephemeral MCP-connected conversation with no inherited research conversation. Actual MCP calls were captured privately. No ChatGPT-web or Claude-account test is claimed.
limitations: Small task-oriented evaluation, not a model ranking or statistical reliability estimate.
Prompts explicitly requested the connected research tools; this does not prove unprompted tool discovery.
Live totals and trial statuses may change; these observations describe the dated source snapshot.
Host network permissions materially affect file download; access to MCP does not imply arbitrary outbound file retrieval.

tasks.task: Find, read and cite a known paper
tasks.prompt: Find the Davis psilocybin depression trial with DOI 10.1001/jamapsychiatry.2020.3285, read its public record, and give title, year, DOI, source URL and citation. Explain whether it is full paper text.
checks: Exact DOI and source PMID 33146667 returned.
Recorded bibliographic year 2021 preserved rather than guessed from DOI 2020.

tasks.prompt: Find recruiting trials in Germany, show up to five NCT identifiers and registry links, observation date, matching total and pagination.
checks: Reported zero matches rather than fabricating recruiting trials.
Cross-checked three German registry records with other statuses.
Preserved registry observation time and pagination semantics.

tasks.prompt: Give annual/status counts for 2020–2026, whole-catalogue total, missing years, revision and generation time. Explain the counting unit and current-year limitation.
checks: Every reported annual/status count reconciled with the verified SQLite snapshot.
Described records, not independent studies or participants;2026 partial.

tasks.task: Download and verify the full database
tasks.prompt: Use connected research tools to discover, download and verify the complete public SQLite; preserve manifest and report paths, size, SHA-256, actual count, snapshot and generation time.
checks: Actual local file independently checked: 5,472,256 bytes, 5,142 records, SQLite integrity ok.
One earlier network-restricted conversation failed DNS and correctly disclosed that no database was verified.
In the network-enabled test Python received HTTP 403; curl succeeded.

tasks.task: Distinguish reports, cohorts and protocol versions
tasks.prompt: Should the 2014 smoking pilot and 2017 follow-up be counted as independent cohorts? Are the EMBRACE preprint and published protocol completed treatment-result studies? Give evidence, roles, record/source links and coverage limits.
checks: Correctly identified two smoking reports from one original cohort, without adding sample sizes.
Distinguished protocol_preprint, protocol and registration from completed treatment results.
Preserved EMBRACE crossover versus delayed-start design versions.
Cited the exact source evidence and disclosed selected, incomplete study-family coverage.

assessment: Five research-task types succeeded in fresh connected conversations with required network access. Six conversations were run, including one DNS-restricted download failure and its successful network-enabled retry. The restricted failure is retained as a limitation, not counted as successful retrieval.
